autoBlog.title: Auto-blogger (secured)
autoBlog.lead: Generate a draft article as Markdown. Requires server environment variables; requests without the correct bearer token are rejected.
autoBlog.topicPlaceholder: e.g. CSP pitfalls in Next.js App Router
autoBlog.unauthorized: This panel is disabled until AUTO_BLOG_PANEL_SECRET is configured and you sign in with it.
autoBlog.hint: Set AUTO_BLOG_PANEL_SECRET in .env. For AI output, add OPENAI_API_KEY. The public API uses Authorization: Bearer AUTO_BLOG_SECRET.

admin.title: Admin panel
admin.loginFailed: Username, password or 2FA code is incorrect.
admin.twoFactorInvalid: The 2FA code is invalid or expired.
admin.twoFactorDisabled: 2FA is off. Generate a key and add it to the environment as ADMIN_TOTP_SECRET.
admin.bulkLead: Generate multiple scheduled drafts from a topic list.
admin.bulkUseWeb: Web research mode (no LLM API key; fetches public HTTPS pages and writes SEO drafts in EN + TR).
admin.bulkWebSources: Source URLs (one HTTPS URL per line, max 5)
admin.bulkWebSourcesLead: Only use pages you may cite; respect robots.txt and copyright. Drafts are synthesized summaries, not copies.
admin.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this post?
admin.cronLead: Track scheduled publish runs and trigger manually.
admin.sitePostsSynced: Site posts synced and thumbnails uploaded.
admin.builderLead: Elementor-style blocks + AI fill for faster drafting.
admin.mediaUploaded: Image uploaded and added to the post.
admin.builderFilled: Editor fields populated from AI draft.
admin.marketingLead: Manage analytics and AI provider settings from the panel (stored in D1).
admin.customAiApiKeyHintSet: Leave empty to keep existing key
admin.customAiApiKeyHintEmpty: Paste key to enable custom AI provider
admin.smtpLead: Recommended on Cloudflare: use a Brevo API key. SMTP fields remain available as a fallback. Messages are always stored in the database.
admin.brevoApiKeyHintSet: Leave empty to keep the existing Brevo key
admin.smtpPassHintSet: Leave empty to keep the existing password
admin.smtpSecure: Use TLS/SSL (typical for port 465 or STARTTLS on 587)
admin.contactInboxLead: Submissions from the homepage contact form.
admin.loginBlocked: Too many failed attempts. Please try again later.
admin.notConfiguredLead: Set these environment variables in .env (local) or as Cloudflare secrets (production), then restart or redeploy:
admin.notConfiguredHint: Generate the password hash and session secret with:
admin.d1MissingLead: Posts, messages, bookings and settings are stored in D1. Check the BLOG_DB binding in wrangler.jsonc and run the migrations. Login and security work without it.
admin.d1RequiredSection: This section needs the D1 database.
admin.securityLead: Admin credentials are read from environment variables, never from the database.
admin.checkSession: Signed session cookie (8 h, HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict)
admin.checkRateLimit: Login rate limiting (5 failures → 15 min lock)
admin.twoFactorDisableHint: To turn it off, remove ADMIN_TOTP_SECRET from the environment.
admin.twoFactorStep1: Add the key to your authenticator app (or open the link on your phone).
admin.twoFactorStep2: Enter a code below to check it works.
admin.twoFactorStep3: Save the line in .env or as a Cloudflare secret, then restart or redeploy.
admin.twoFactorTestOk: Code is valid. Now save ADMIN_TOTP_SECRET to the environment.
admin.signOutAllHint: To sign out every session at once, change ADMIN_SESSION_SECRET. Changing the password or 2FA key does the same.
